meta.source: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), product and UPI ecosystem statistics, captured by the local Data Bank
meta.vintageNote: NPCI publishes no revision date for its statistics and edits past rows in place without notice; these are its tables as the Data Bank captured them on the archiveCapturedDate.
meta.revisionPolicy: NPCI edits past rows in place without notice (it revised April 2023's UPI volume, and NETC's February and March 2026 in October 2026). Each capture is the table as NPCI then showed it; the Data Bank keeps every capture.
meta.base: NPCI UPI ecosystem statistics: districts (from March 2026)
meta.coverage: UPI in every district NPCI lists, each month since March 2026: number and value of transactions and each district's share of all UPI
meta.sourceTitle: NPCI, UPI ecosystem statistics: state-wise, district rows (monthly)
meta.note: District rows NPCI added under each state from March 2026. Districts are named as NPCI prints them, which may differ from the Census or LGD names. The unclassified 40 to 45% of transactions has no district either. Districts sum to their state's total; validate checks it.
